bullets.text: Full-year CR 93.4 despite two Category 4 hurricanes; auto programs estimated ~10 pts more profitable than industry; Property CR 105.1, including ~6.7 pts of ARX amortization expense; CL NPW surpassed $3B.
Companywide NPW grew 16%, adding $3.8B after $2.8B in 2016; Property DPW rose 15% to $1.35B (home, condo, renters, dwelling fire +21% to $1.24B); auto market share believed up ~0.5 pts to almost 10%.
Auto PIF +13%; new auto apps +18%; bundled Robinsons PIF +30%+; trailing 12-month auto PLE up close to 7% (Agency up ~8%); Property PIF reached nearly 1.5M on 48% new application growth.

Severe thunderstorms added 25.6 pts to Property CR, with thunderstorm industry catastrophe losses >60% above 20-year average; Irma and Harvey added 5.1 and 1.7 Property pts; auto storm pricing addressed half the gap.

Persistent favorable auto frequency trends were one reason underwriting margins widened; observed factors included customer mix shifts toward lower pure premium customers and longer trips by Snapshot drivers, viewed as representative of the book.

Portfolio returned 5.2% (equity >21%, fixed income 3%); post-tax comprehensive investment income ~$825M; issued $850M 30-year debt to pre-fund $564M debt security redemption; declared $1.1247/share annual variable dividend.

Personal Lines expense ratio is consistently below 20 points; non-acquisition expenses were reduced >0.5 points over three years; transitioning claims from Service Centers to Network Shop operations is expected to improve operating efficiency.
HomeQuote Explorer helped drive online home and condo new apps +49%, with sales yield improving >50%; Snapshot mobile app rolled out to 42 states plus DC, collecting >33M trips and 300M miles.

Celebrated 10 years of Flo; launched second round of Parentamorphosis creative; more than doubled impressions against homeowner/bundle versus 2015; Direct auto achieved fifth consecutive year of new quote and application growth (+16% in 2017).

Hired almost 6,000 people in 2017 after >6,600 in 2016; 25th Gainshare anniversary scored 1.79 (median payout >$8,100); launched “Unexpectedly Progressive” campaign; adopted purpose statement “True to our name. Progressive.”
